reproduction.commands_are_templates: These are source-supported commands for an authorized fresh environment, not a transcript or new execution. Variables designate operator-provided absolute paths; no private paths are published.
reproduction.prerequisites: Build with the source-gate command on each native host. Linux requires GTK/X11/AT-SPI/D-Bus dependencies, an owned empty private absolute profile directory, an existing verified GGUF and authorized disposable desktop environment. No model download or copy is implied. Mac layout-only requires neither Controller/model nor a profile. Native Windows is not reproduced here.

source_capture.timing: Post-run current working-tree source capture, not a frozen prelaunch attestation.

historical_evidence.interpretation: Prior zero-sentinel correction observations are historical and unchanged. The linked public receipt has publication-provenance metadata updates; sha256 and bytes identify that public file, not the privately retained original. Its Mac 8.6 GB observation was real decimal presentation of 8589934592 bytes before this RAM-unit fix; its Windows raw-byte statement was source-only historical behavior. Neither is rewritten as a GiB observation.

privacy: Private model/profile paths, process identifiers, account identities and session handles omitted. Raw outputs are identified by byte digests, not private navigation locations.
